analyzed_vuln.description: In xmlParseEntityDecl, the parser assumes enough buffered input after matching "<!ENTITY" and unconditionally executes SKIP(6) (parser.c:5364) after only SHRINK (not GROW). With malformed/edge input (here via schema parsing of a crafted XML with odd encoding and truncated DTD entity declaration), the input cursor can be at/near buffer boundary and SKIP reads past the end of the current global input buffer, causing a 1-byte global-buffer-overflow read.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered through fuzz/schema.c -> xmlSchemaParse -> xmlSchemaAddSchemaDoc -> xmlCtxtReadFile -> xmlParseDocument -> xmlParseInternalSubset -> xmlParseMarkupDecl -> xmlParseEntityDecl when the document contains an internal subset with an ENTITY declaration prefix that drives the parser into xmlParseEntityDecl but does not provide safely available bytes for the fixed SKIP(6). The PoV uses a crafted header/encoding and malformed DTD/entity text so parsing reaches this path with insufficient buffered data, leading to OOB read.
